_comment: A filled-in spec for a fictional customer, to show the shape. Never copy the
colours. Generate your own starting point with:
so the swatch ids and roles come from the export you were actually given.
Keys the build reads: brand, font, activate, headerBar, swatches, palettes,
literalOverrides, checkAgainst. Anything starting with _ is ignored.

_note: apply:false leaves typography alone. Only set true once the font is
confirmed registered on the tenant, and check whether weights were
registered as one family or several - 'Inter' with a bold flag behaves
differently from a separate 'Inter SemiBold' family.
fallback appends a stack, e.g. 'Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif'. Worth
setting if the font might not resolve for every viewer.

BackgroundColor_30._note: Activates a spare slot for a role the stock set lacks. Drop this block if the brand has no coloured title bars. See references/sac-theme-schema.md Trap 5.

headerBar._note: Omit entirely unless the customer's reports put a coloured bar behind widget titles.

literalOverrides._note: Only for colours the build reports as ambiguous or off-palette. One source colour shared by swatches that now diverge cannot be remapped automatically.

palettes._note: variance is [negative, positive]. single_color is the recently-used row in the colour picker - handy place for the core brand colours.

swatches._note: role is documentation, carried over from the export. color is what you edit.
swatches._truncated: A real spec lists every assigned swatch the export declares - typically around 106. The emitted starter file already has them all.
